# v13.3.0 release notes, iteration 2: the grid frames and the merges since

## Context

#19712 is the epic for Engine 13.3.0's release notes. Iteration 1 merged as #19748 (`d9e78ed17d`). It left the screenshots to the next iteration, with the images hosted in `neomjs/pages`. The handover on #19712 ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19712#issuecomment-6190112868)) set this iteration's scope: capture, host, embed, and fold in the merges since iteration 1.

## The Problem

- The two grid chapters describe visual features without a single frame.
- *13.3 in 2 Minutes* says of `columnMenu` that "no shipped example turns it on yet". #19750 (`d1812dbb84`) made that false: `examples/grid/bigData`'s Settings tab now has a "Column menus" checkbox.
- The scale line and the *Full Changelog* count 48 PRs and 50 closed issues at 2026-10-15 09:00Z. Live GitHub at 11:10Z counts 51 and 53. The new PRs are #19743, #19748 and #19750.

## The Architectural Reality

- The note is `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.3.0.md`, iterated on `dev` behind its banner (release-notes §1, §6).
- `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Generate.spec.mjs` refuses `blob/main` and tag-ref Neo source links in release notes. Image URLs on `raw.githubusercontent.com/neomjs/pages/main/…` are the 13.2 precedent (`v13.2.0.md`).
- The frames come from neomjs/pages#39. They were captured at `d1812dbb84` from `examples/grid/contentSizedRows` and `examples/grid/bigData`.

## The Fix

In `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.3.0.md`:
- **Frames:** `grid-content-sized-rows.png` in the content-sized rows chapter; `grid-header-menu-counts.png` and `grid-header-menu-filtered.png` in the header-menus chapter; `grid-header-menu-refine.png` beside the 1,000-match bound in its *Numbers*. Each frame gets alt text that describes it.
- **Short route:** name the bigData checkbox as the way to see header menus.
- **Merges since iteration 1:** the scale line and the *Full Changelog* re-run against live GitHub at a stated time, with #19743, #19748 and #19750 in their areas.
- **Banner:** iteration 2; the remaining work (designation, the cut's receipt, numbers regenerated at the cut head) stays listed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 The four frames are embedded with descriptive alt text, from `raw.githubusercontent.com/neomjs/pages/main/resources_pub/website/release-notes/v13.3.0/`.
- [ ] AC-2 No sentence says that no shipped example turns `columnMenu` on; the short route names bigData's "Column menus" checkbox.
- [ ] AC-3 The scale line and the *Full Changelog* name their source and time, and list every PR merged since iteration 1.
- [ ] AC-4 `Generate.spec.mjs` passes.
- [ ] AC-5 A GPT-family review approves before merge (release-notes §5).
- [x] AC-6 Once neomjs/pages#39's PR merges, the four images render in GitHub's view of the note on `dev` (Post-Merge Validation, if the pages merge comes second). Verified at 12:34Z; receipt on #19754.

## Out of Scope

- Hosting the PNGs: neomjs/pages#39.
- The final iteration: the cut's receipt from #19652, removing the banner, `Release Type` and `Stability`, numbers regenerated at the cut head, the §7 checklist.
- A frame of the cut or the e2e tier: neither has a visual surface.

## Avoided Traps

- **Photographing a page the feature was patched into for the shot.** Every frame is a shipped example on `dev`, reachable by the reader.
- **Rounding the new merges into the old count.** The 09:00Z numbers stay true for their time; the iteration states the new time.
